lines.text: Why is this black blacker than my TV?
Because it's not showing black. It's showing nothing.
Deep. Put that on a mug.
Every dot on that new tablet is its own tiny lamp.
The O is for organic. A thin layer that glows when powered.
So my screen is a stadium full of phone flashlights?
Sure. And for black, those lamps just switch off.
Hold up. Black is just the lights being off?
Yep. A regular LCD TV can't do that.
One big light sits behind the whole screen, always on.
Liquid crystals twist like tiny blinds to block it.
But blinds leak. So your black is really dark gray.
So my TV's been gaslighting me in gray.
Your TV is a night light with ambition.
So what's the catch with the lamp one?
Leave one image up for ages and those lamps wear unevenly.
That's burn-in. A faint ghost that sticks around.
A haunted screen? Sick.
Not sick. And now you know.
Wait. Then explain this one...
